parameters.query:
INSERT INTO analysis_runs (history_id, workflow_execution_id, status, current_step, request, tenant_id, access_groups, decision_state, started_at)
VALUES ('integration-test', $1::text, 'running', 'step_09_spatial_layout', '{}'::jsonb, 'default', ARRAY['planning'],
  jsonb_build_object('steps', '{}'::jsonb, 'evidence_index', '{}'::jsonb, 'conflicts', '[]'::jsonb, 'open_questions', '[]'::jsonb, 'revisions', '[]'::jsonb), NOW())
RETURNING id::text AS run_id, decision_state;
